chapterTitle: Chapter 16 Chemistry of Benzene: Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution
title: Problem 16-8

pages.text: PROBLEM 16-8 Rank the compounds in each of the following groups in order of their reactivity to electrophilic substitution: (a) Nitrobenzene, phenol, toluene, benzene (b) Phenol, benzene, chlorobenzene, benzoic acid (c) Benzene, bromobenzene, benzaldehyde, aniline
